pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Stellate and polygonal dark-pigmented regions with high-frequency angular edges. Individual patches exhibit irregular vertex distribution and sharp contrast boundaries against the light background pelage.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light-colored pathways with variable pixel width. The topology is defined by frequent tri-radial junction nodes and high spatial continuity across the visible torso and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-grained, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the upper neck boundary. The texture is consistent with a short, stiff mane forming a continuous jagged 1D profile against the background.
